message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a hearty, traditional lasagna:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (per 9‑x‑13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 3–4 cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | 2 Tbsp chopped |
| | Water or broth (to adjust consistency) | ½–1 cup |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (optional) | 2 Tbsp chopped |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2–3 cups |
| **Parmesan** | Grated Parmesan cheese (for topping) | ½ cup |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms (sautéed) | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper (diced) | 1 cup |
| | Ricotta or cottage cheese (for extra creaminess) | ½ cup |

### Quick Tips
- **No‑boil pasta** saves time; just add a splash of water to the sauce if it looks too thick.
- For a richer flavor, brown the meat with onions and garlic before adding tomatoes.
- Mix the ricotta with egg, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and herbs to create a creamy layer.
- Layer: start with a thin sauce layer, then pasta, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan on top.
- Bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 45–55 minutes, covered with foil for the first 30 minutes, then uncovered for the last 15–20 minutes to brown the top.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
